_comment: Data tables the match server needs. Each is pinned by SHA-256; check-oss fails on any other file under match/data/ or on a changed hash. Re-pin only after reviewing the diff. None of these contains recorded traffic.

ability-grants.json.source: ability spec lists decoded from recorded match traffic (handles, ability class paths, levels, input ids)

learned-floor-seed-204.json.source: walkable positions learned from our own test matches

netlayout.json.source: replication field order of engine/game classes, from the game executable

spawnpoints-204.json.source: spawn actor locations from the game's map files

sv-funcflags-204.json.source: function flags from the game executable's reflection data

sv-replayout-204.json.source: replication layouts from the game executable's reflection data

usmap-enums-204.json.source: enum names and values from the game's type mappings
